highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 engine update with upstream renderer bug fixes.
highlights_body: Linux applications that rely on fontconfig's exact fallback face should verify text metrics after upgrading.

bullets.detail: Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 153 and incorporates upstream Chrome m153 bug fixes without changing the managed API surface.

bullets.lead: Linux font fallback follows the updated Skia behavior
bullets.detail: Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the prior FcFontSort path. Apps that require a specific fallback face should select an explicit family and style or bundle the typeface.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Preview 1 opens the 4.153 line with Skia m153 and its upstream renderer fixes.

v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Preview 1 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m153.
v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.body: It incorporates upstream Chrome m153 fixes while preserving the managed API surface. Linux applications that depend on an exact fontconfig fallback face should verify their text output.
